input.quote: (a) Kubient agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer and its officers, directors, managers, members, agents, and employees from all third-party allegations, claims, actions, losses, expenses, damages, costs (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees) or liabilities ("Claims") arising out of or in connection with:
input.rationale: Section 10(a) contains a broad Kubient (Vendor) defence and indemnity in our favour covering third-party Claims arising out of the Services (p0048), the Auction Platform (p0049), Kubient's breach of any representation or warranty, and the acts or omissions of Kubient and its subcontractors (p0051). IP infringement is captured both by the "Services"/"Auction Platform" prongs and via the express non-infringement warranty at Section 9(b)(i) (p0033); Vendor's compliance-with-law (p0037, p0041) and data-security (p0035) warranties feed the same breach-of-warranty prong, so the preferred prongs (IP, breach of law, data breach, misconduct) are all reached. Section 11 (p0053–p0055) supplies standard procedure (prompt notice with no forfeiture for delay, indemnitor control with no liability-admitting settlement without our consent, cooperation at indemnitor's cost), and the Section 7(a) limitation expressly carves out indemnification liability, so Vendor's indemnity is uncapped — better than the fallback super-cap. AP's reciprocal indemnity in Section 10(b) is a mirror of Kubient's and is centred on AP's Content and Properties and its own use/acts, which is an acceptable balanced bargain; no redline warranted.
